name: Pigment Yellow 128
description: Pigment Yellow 128 (CAS 79953-85-8 ), also marketed under the trade name Cromophtal Yellow L 0990, is a high-performance azo condensation pigment delivering strong, clean yellow shades. It offers exceptional lightfastness and heat stability for demanding colorant applications. This pigment is ideal for use where durability under processing or outdoor exposure is a primary sourcing requirement. In automotive OEM and refinish coatings, it meets the stringent weathering and heat resistance standards required for exterior topcoats. Plastics compounders select it for engineering polymers and masterbatch production where processing temperatures are critical. It ensures long-term color retention in various polymer matrices and high-performance plastic applications. Packaging and commercial printing applications benefit from its high tinting strength in offset, gravure, and flexographic ink systems. It provides a bright, stable yellow needed in pigment printing pastes or surface coatings. Textile and paper applications utilize this pigment for its reliability and vibrant color profile. Pigment Yellow 128 is supplied as a dry powder, typically in press cake or flushed paste form for industrial ink and coating applications. It is available in technical and high-purity grades, with specific surface treatment variants offered to optimize dispersibility. These treatments are designed for solvent-borne, water-borne, or specialized plastics systems. Packaging is standard in fiber drums or bags, with bulk quantities available for industrial users. The material is handled according to strict quality protocols to ensure consistency across different production batches and global shipments.
